product_metadata.title: KIKAR H3O Water Stick Portable Hydrogen Generator Wand, Generates Hydrogen Water in just 3mins
features: - Produce Hydrogen Ion water in just 3 mins
- Hydrogen concentration: about 550 ppb (* depending on type of water and contents of impurities)
description: KIKAR Hydrogen Stick produces hydrogen ions and turns water into micro-molecular clusters. Hydrogen ion is the nemesis of malignant free radicals. Due to the micro-molecular water clusters, the hydrogen ion could be freely moving between mitochondrion, rapidly eliminates the hazardous free radicals. Benefit of drinking hydrogen water includes: anti-oxidant, anti-aging, elimination of free radicals, cell protection, metabolism, boosting, improve health condition, etc.

Features: - Produce Hydrogen Ion water in just 3 mins - Easy-to-use one-button design - Compact and lightweight - Hydrogen concentration: about 550 ppb (* depending on type of water and contents of impurities) - Stylish design - With USB cable

How to Use: 1. Remove the protective cap; connect the USB cable. 2. Fill a glass with about 200ml of water. 3. Place the KIKAR Hydrogen Stick in the glass and press the power button. 4. The blue LED illuminates after switch on, and it starts producing hydrogen.  5. The blue LED will be off after 3 minutes when production of hydrogen ion water is completed.
Note: For best result, DO NOT use excessively hard water or distilled water. (Boiled tap water or mineral water is recommended.)

Product Specifications: Main part size: 170x23.5x14mm Weight: about 50 g Power supply: DC5V Rated power: 2.0W Timer: about 3 minutes Using temperature range: 5 - 40°С Main part material: aluminum. PCT-G electrode part: pure titanium + platinum electroplating Accessory: USB cable
Package Contents:  KIKAR Hydrogen Stick x 1 USB Cable x 1  User Manual x 1 Gift Box x 1
